lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb2Fe12 (reduced formula TbFe6) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 14 atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in two distinct 12-coordinate close-packed-like local arrangements, while Tb centers are 18-coordinate with Fe neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Fe 12-vertex polyhedra and corner and face sharing between Fe and Tb polyhedra.
